hints.title: Hierarchical Tree Bitwise Merging
hints.text: Merge two quadrant trees recursively, short-circuiting when either node is a uniform leaf.

hints.title: Leaf Short-Circuit and Collapse
hints.text: If quadTree1 is a leaf with true value, return quadTree1. If a leaf with false, return quadTree2. Otherwise recurse on four quadrants and collapse if all four become uniform leaves.

hints.title: Recursive Quad Merge Blueprint
hints.text: If t1.isLeaf: return t1 if t1.val else t2. If t2.isLeaf: return t2 if t2.val else t1. Recurse on tl, tr, bl, br. If all 4 are leaves with same val: return Node(tl.val, True). Else return Node(0, False, tl, tr, bl, br).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of nodes in trees
complexity.notes: Visits overlapping quadrants recursively, bounded by the number of tree nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Decompressing quad trees into full grids takes exponential O(2^2H) space and time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct tree intersection operates in-place without rasterization.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of leaf short-circuiting and quad-leaf collapse logic.

solutions.approach: C++ Recursive Quad Merging and Pruning
